decisions.owner_statement: I think we can discard qwen2.5-omni as an option. Lets spike your recommendation

preferred_tts_candidate.reason: Owner found both models understandable in English and German, preferred Pocket and heard an English accent in Qwen3's German Ryan voice.
preferred_tts_candidate.continuation: Owner approved continuing on the current M3 Max while the M1 is unavailable. English/German streaming, cancellation and process reuse are implemented at the service boundary.
preferred_tts_candidate.next_hardware_evaluation: Pocket TTS with Godot and the local dialogue model on current M3, followed by actual M1 16 GB when available; neither combined-budget measurement has been performed.
